title: Floor Area Regulations for R6 Through R12 Districts
description: Master FAR table for all R6-R12 districts. Standard residences and qualifying affordable/senior housing get separate columns. Updated with Universal Affordability Preference (UAP).

key_rules: Maximum residential FAR set per district per table in §23-22
Separate FARs for standard residences vs. qualifying affordable/senior housing
UAP (Universal Affordability Preference) increases FAR for qualifying affordable or senior housing
Community facility FAR in R6-R12 per ZR §24-11 — shall not exceed residential FAR unless modified
Floor area regulations for R1-R5 per §23-21 (separate table)
Special floor area provisions for multiple dwelling residences per §23-23
notes: R8 (no suffix) within 100 ft of wide street: FAR 7.20 standard / 8.64 qualifying per footnote 1
R9/R10 within Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas: separate MIH requirements apply
Per §23-22, community facility FAR shall not exceed residential FAR in R6-R12
Special provisions for certain community districts per §23-242 (e.g., Manhattan CD7: R8 within certain areas)
footnotes: 1: Within 100 ft of a wide street
2: Outside of MIH areas, for zoning lots within 100 ft of wide street containing UAP or qualifying senior housing

dob_filing_notes: Confirm district designation on NYC DCP zoning map ( ZoLa: zoningmaps.cityofnewyork.us )
If UAP affordable housing: document eligibility per ZR §23-22
Community facility FAR vs. residential FAR requires analysis per §24-11
